title.en: Organize the college catalog by number and specialty
title.zh: 按学院编号与专业方向整理学院目录

purpose.en: Make the administrator-built college catalog predictable and align its four colleges with language, business, career, and test-preparation learning.
purpose.zh: 让管理员预置学院目录按稳定编号清晰展示，并将四个学院调整为语言、商务、职业与备考方向。

en: Display college cards in ascending college-number order from 820101 through 820104.
Rename the four seeded colleges to SmartLingo Language College, Business College, Career College, and Test Prep College.
Expose exactly three active catalog tags: General, Professional, and Test Prep.
Add the administrator-built English Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced courses to Language College while retaining its introduction course.
zh: 学院卡片按 820101 至 820104 的学院编号升序显示。
将四个预置学院改为 SmartLingo 语言学院、商务学院、职业学院和备考学院。
学院目录只显示三个有效标签：通用、专业、备考。
语言学院在保留导论课程的同时，加入管理员预置的英语初级、中级、高级课程。

en: Add one idempotent forward D1 migration that preserves college IDs, numbers, ownership, joins, and existing member records.
Map Language College to General; map Business and Career colleges to Professional; and map Test Prep College to Test Prep.
Deactivate the obsolete Lifestyle tag after moving its college to Professional.
Reuse the existing official course records instead of duplicating curriculum, pricing, or enrollment state.
zh: 新增一个可重复安全执行的向前 D1 迁移，保留学院 ID、编号、所有权、加入关系及现有会员记录。
语言学院归入通用标签，商务学院与职业学院归入专业标签，备考学院归入备考标签。
职业学院迁移至专业标签后停用旧生活方式标签。
直接复用现有正式课程记录，不重复创建课程内容、价格或报名状态。

en: Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and SmartLingo shared-contract gates pass.
The production build, strict TypeScript check, sensitive-data scan, artifact validation, migration checks, and all 320 repository tests pass.
The college behavior test verifies ascending number order, four new college identities, three active tag categories, and all three administrator courses.
The WebKit runtime layout matrix passes 260/260 combinations across 26 routes, two interface languages, and five phone, iPad, and desktop viewports.
zh: 共享规则、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 共享合约门禁通过。
生产构建、严格 TypeScript 检查、敏感数据扫描、产物验证、迁移检查及全部 320 项仓库测试通过。
学院行为测试确认编号升序、四个新学院名称、三个有效标签类别及三门管理员课程。
WebKit 运行时布局矩阵 260/260 通过，覆盖 26 条路由、两种界面语言及五种手机、iPad 与桌面视口。

en: The three added level courses currently use the established English official-course records; additional target languages remain available through Choose Course.
zh: 本次加入的三门分级课程复用现有英语正式课程；其他目标语言仍可从“选择课程”进入。

en: This is a SmartLingo-specific catalog and data migration; it changes no shared identity, commerce, classroom, or external-service boundary.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属的学院目录与数据迁移，不改变共享身份、商业、课程教室或外部服务边界。
